## MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the Current Market Regime?
RISK-ON: low volatility (Vol: 16.5%) with full-sector participation (Breadth: 8/8); market tone is broad-based bullish.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Technology & Telecom (1W: +11.94% | 1M: -0.34%) led by TTKOM (1W: +19.78% | 1M: +7.99%) ABOVE TREND and KONTR (1W: +8.70% | 1M: -8.62%) RECOVERY. Energy & Chemicals (1W: +10.51% | 1M: +12.91%) led by SASA (1W: +26.46% | 1M: +13.25%) ABOVE TREND and PETKM (1W: +22.06% | 1M: +32.62%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Holding & Investment (1W: +2.94% | 1M: +6.35%) is the weakest of the advance with SAHOL (1W: +2.47% | 1M: +7.99%) ABOVE TREND and DOHOL (1W: +2.15% | 1M: +1.48%) ABOVE TREND. Transportation (1W: +3.38% | 1M: -0.95%) shows relative lag with THYAO (1W: +3.00% | 1M: -2.75%) RECOVERY.

## STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
SASA (1W: +26.46% | 1M: +13.25%) ABOVE TREND; PETKM (1W: +22.06% | 1M: +32.62%) ABOVE TREND; TTKOM (1W: +19.78% | 1M: +7.99%) ABOVE TREND; SISE (1W: +16.29% | 1M: +9.81%) ABOVE TREND; TOASO (1W: +15.07% | 1M: +11.74%) ABOVE TREND.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
THYAO (1W: +3.00% | 1M: -2.75%) RECOVERY; TSKB (1W: +2.90% | 1M: +2.81%) ABOVE TREND; SAHOL (1W: +2.47% | 1M: +7.99%) ABOVE TREND; YKBNK (1W: +2.23% | 1M: +2.80%) ABOVE TREND; DOHOL (1W: +2.15% | 1M: +1.48%) ABOVE TREND.

6. Momentum Stocks?
SASA (1W: +26.46% | 1M: +13.25%) ABOVE TREND; PETKM (1W: +22.06% | 1M: +32.62%) ABOVE TREND; TTKOM (1W: +19.78% | 1M: +7.99%) ABOVE TREND; SISE (1W: +16.29% | 1M: +9.81%) ABOVE TREND; TOASO (1W: +15.07% | 1M: +11.74%) ABOVE TREND.

## SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Banking Sector Outlook?
Banking is participating but trailing cyclicals; AKBNK (1W: +1.61% | 1M: +5.67%) ABOVE TREND, GARAN (1W: +2.13% | 1M: +2.44%) ABOVE TREND, ISCTR (1W: +7.57% | 1M: +10.91%) ABOVE TREND, VAKBN (1W: +12.86% | 1M: +23.16%) ABOVE TREND, HALKB (1W: +1.13% | 1M: +45.01%) ABOVE TREND, YKBNK (1W: +2.23% | 1M: +2.80%) ABOVE TREND, TSKB (1W: +2.90% | 1M: +2.81%) ABOVE TREND.

8. Industrial Sector Outlook?
Heavy industry showing clear strength; EREGL (1W: +7.71% | 1M: +5.97%) ABOVE TREND, FROTO (1W: +9.52% | 1M: +3.89%) ABOVE TREND, TOASO (1W: +15.07% | 1M: +11.74%) ABOVE TREND, ASELS (1W: +3.55% | 1M: +3.35%) ABOVE TREND — cyclical exposure is rewarding.

9. Energy & Chemicals Outlook?
Energy & Chemicals are the pulse of the rally: TUPRS (1W: +5.75% | 1M: +17.72%) ABOVE TREND, PETKM (1W: +22.06% | 1M: +32.62%) ABOVE TREND, SASA (1W: +26.46% | 1M: +13.25%) ABOVE TREND, SISE (1W: +16.29% | 1M: +9.81%) ABOVE TREND, HEKTS (1W: +9.23% | 1M: -0.35%) RECOVERY.

## PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Risk-on posture: overweight Energy & Chemicals and select Heavy Industry (autos, steel) while adding tactical exposure to Tech winners; trim lagging defensives only if profit targets met and reallocate into high-momentum names.

## NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
SASA (1W: +26.46% | 1M: +13.25%) ABOVE TREND; PETKM (1W: +22.06% | 1M: +32.62%) ABOVE TREND; TTKOM (1W: +19.78% | 1M: +7.99%) ABOVE TREND; TUPRS (1W: +5.75% | 1M: +17.72%) ABOVE TREND; TOASO (1W: +15.07% | 1M: +11.74%) ABOVE TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
Energy & Chemicals for momentum follow-through and earnings/commodity sensitivity; Technology & Telecom for continuation of large short-term moves and rotation dynamics; Heavy Industry for cyclical confirmation.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
XU100 confirmation: sustained break above recent highs would signal extension of the risk-on move; a sharp reversal below the 1-month uptrend or a volatility uptick would signal profit-taking. Watch global oil, Turkish macro prints and CBRT communications, and quarterly updates from PETKM/SASA/TOASO as immediate catalysts.

EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
RISK-ON environment with Vol 16.5% and 8/8 sector participation; Energy & Chemicals and Tech-led momentum are driving the advance. Opportunity in cyclicals (SASA, PETKM, TOASO, TTKOM) but monitor macro/catalyst risk and intraday volatility for tactical exits.
